name: Belmond Sanctuary Lodge
positioning: Belmond's Sanctuary Lodge, a short walk from the Machu Picchu entrance
best_for: Travelers who want to stay within a short walk of the Machu Picchu entrance
Guests who want to arrive by the Hiram Bingham train

facts.text: The lodge is a 3 minute walk from the Machu Picchu entrance.
Tampu Bar has a pisco-focused menu.
The lodge offers cooking classes and tasting experiences.
The lodge is a 25 minute drive from Aguas Calientes train station.
The train journey from Cusco takes 3.5 hours.
The train journey from Ollantaytambo takes 1.5 hours.

highlights.text: The lodge originally housed explorers and researchers before becoming a Belmond hotel in 1999.
The lodge is a 3 minute walk from the Machu Picchu entrance.
Guests can arrive aboard the Hiram Bingham train.
Celebrations at the lodge include shaman-led vow renewals.
Wellness treatments are given in a massage room.

considerations.text: The lodge is a 25 minute drive from Aguas Calientes train station, and the train journey from Cusco takes 3.5 hours.
WhataHotel notes an extremely remote mountain location.
WhataHotel notes limited dining and entertainment options due to isolation.
